about: Blind label review of the AUD-77 evaluation-2 datasets, 2026-10-23. Two independent reviewers per dataset (AI reviewers, fresh sessions, no access to repo code, labels, references, validator rules or any model output) labelled shuffled items with opaque ids. "author_label" is the label that was frozen in PR #78. Reviewers are the same model family as the author: a human second review is still recommended. Synthetic text only.
